title: MallWorld was attacked last night
content: Last night I was in mallworld and bombs were dropped on us. It felt very real and I have never experienced anything like this before. I was looking out a window and could see a large bomb being dropped on this small city. Then bombs were being dropped closer and closer to me. I didn’t know if I should leave the building or stay. I felt like I was going to die at any second. A friend even ran back in the building for me to find my dog. Anyone else have a similar dream?
